cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take the other end of this table. Knees bent, the way I taught you when we first moved into this workshop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm stronger now. I can carry it alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Strong enough not to drop your end, at last. Leave me mine; I'd like a partner today, not a removal service.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Take that end, and we'll put it by the window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask me about the window first. You used to wait for every instruction; now we can each have a vote. Hold your end while I tell you where I'd like it.
